designGoals: Each shard is a balanced mini-corpus, not a mono-stratum batch.
Parallel audit/remediation can run per shard without waiting for full 3000.
Global uniqueness and global quotas remain authoritative; shard quotas are local envelopes.
No shard becomes a covert overfitting lane for one trap family.

perShardPrimaryHomeEnvelope.note: Exact integers; 12 shards × values = global primary homes.

exactPerShardPrimaryHome.explanation: digital remainder on S01–S06 (+1); disclosure remainder on S07–S12 (+1). All shards total 250.

S01.notes: First shard authorised for any future dry-run selection only after plan acceptance.

S02.notes: Must not be a cosmetic near-copy of S01; same envelopes, distinct combined semantic signatures (L2), not manufactured ID/salt diversity.

S09_to_S10.notes: Still obey envelopes, but prefer packing remaining heavy/complex coupling slack here if global floors need catch-up.

S11_to_S12.notes: May later host sealed-truth delayed validation under separate custody protocol; not selected or sealed by this blueprint.

order: Assign L1 identities and L2 combined semantic signatures under layered uniqueness policy (no generation here).
Fill primaryStratumHome quotas into shard envelopes.
Backfill remaining cross-cutting floors globally with shard-cap checks.
Reject L1 duplicates, combined-signature duplicates, dominance-cap breaches, and cosmetic-uniqueness hits; do not reject shared public forms or single-dimension clusters alone.
allocationAlgorithmPolicy.rebalancing: If a shard cannot meet a floor without violating a cap, move candidate to another shard; never manufacture uniqueness via IDs/salts/cosmetics.
allocationAlgorithmPolicy.noSequentialFamilyFill: Do not fill shard 1 with all of one family then shard 2 with the next.

parallelismPolicy.shardIndependence: Shard processing must not mutate another shard's membership or truth keys.
parallelismPolicy.globalLedgerRequired: Coverage-gap and uniqueness reports remain global, with per-shard rollups.

exitDeclarationPolicyPerShard.browserSpread: At least 4 shards must contain ≥1 browser_declared_available case when that floor is filled later.

forbiddenShardPatterns: All heavy cases concentrated in one shard
All youth/Welsh/interpreter/PII cases concentrated in one shard
All appeal/Newton cases concentrated in one shard
A shard that is >50% easy routine_volume
A shard used as cosmetic clone farm of another shard
